component.name: Redux Video Player
component.summary: Play your videos, in any format

description.p: A simple video player for your own files, built on VLC 4. It plays practically every video, audio and subtitle format without hunting for codecs, and keeps only the features people actually use.
The interface follows Juxtopposed's redesign of VLC. Not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN.
First development build: VLC 4 with a lean plugin set and a full codec test.
